title: Iowa County’s wind turbines turn into $2.71 million for roads, bridges and schools
summary_full: In Howard County, wind turbines have emerged as a significant revenue stream for public finances. The impressive $2.7 million generated in tax revenue supports vital infrastructure, such as bridges and roads, as well as local educational institutions. This funding helps sustain developments without placing the financial burden on residents. Additionally, land-lease agreements with developers provide farmers with a valuable source of income, enhancing the county's economic landscape.
